## Background

We ran 3 AlphaFold2 predictions,

- HIV-PR_monomer
- HIV-PR_dimer
- My find-a-gene protein sequence

Here we analyze the resulting modles and make some diagnostic plots that inform on model reliability

## 1. HIV-PR Monomer

```{r}
list.files(path = "HIV_monomer_94b5b",
           full.names = F,
           pattern = ".pdb")
```


```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(path = "HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                        full.names = T,
                        pattern = ".pdb")
```

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit = TRUE, exefile = "msa")
pdbs
```

Calculate the RMSD of all models to each other

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)

range(rd)
```


```{r}
library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

Calculate RMSF - how far apart each amino-acid is from

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)

plot.bio3d(rf)
```

### Residue conservation

Read the AF MSA

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path="HIV_monomer_94b5b",
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln_file

aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

We can score residue conservation in the alignment with the conserv() function.
```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

Plot this conservation result
```{r}
plot(sim, type = "h")
```

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

For a final visualization of these functionally important sites we can map this conservation score to the Occupancy column of a PDB file for viewing in molecular viewer programs such as Mol*, PyMol, VMD, chimera etc.

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(sim[1:99], m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```


## AF Scores (plDDT & PAE score plots)


The pLDDT scores are stored in the PDB models "B-factor" col and in a seperate JSON format file in the results directory. We can use either:
```{r}
plotb3(pdbs$b[1,], typ = "l", lwd = 2)
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="red")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="blue")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="darkgreen")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="orange")

#plot(m1.pdb$atom$b[m1.pdb$calpha], typ = "h")
```
